scope: Android LAN result room, rematch, chat, native result PNG storage/share/open, and safe communication event viewer source implementation

runtime.initialObservationNote: The initial E16 adb query returned no devices; see followUp after USB debugging was completed.

implementation.resultRoom: Result expiration is ended_at_ms + 300000 ms. Rematch response deadline is min(request time + 30000 ms, fixed result-room expiration). Loser requests; stored winner accepts or declines; requester can cancel. After decline/cancel/response expiry, a 10-second cooldown allows another request while the original result room remains open. Acceptance stores rematch transition and a new UUID game with an empty board, requester WHITE, responder BLACK, same authorityPlayerId, BLACK to move, new 60s deadline, and revision 0 in one SQLite transaction.
implementation.chat: Participant-only gameId/messageId/body commands; 1-200 Unicode code points; 5 messages per sender per rolling five seconds; last 100 rows and independent per-game sequence. Message ID/body hash supports same-ID manual retry. Finished games are read-only; expiry deletes message bodies and replay hashes. UI stores a per-game draft and does not auto-send after reconnection; composition and keyCode 229 block Enter during Korean IME composition.
implementation.png: Kotlin Canvas renderer uses final board, names/colors, result title/reason, winning move marker for five-in-a-row, and local save timestamp. Explicit render fields exclude chat, token, address, and identifiers. API 29+ MediaStore Pictures/DanpanOmok, legacy ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, ACTION_VIEW, ACTION_SEND with URI read grant.
implementation.communication: Actual LanTransport RPC write/read and authority socket receive/reply hooks. In-memory ArrayDeque bounded to 200 events. Metadata only: type/direction/time/coordinates/revision/UTF-8 JSON bytes/short IDs/chat codepoint count. No token, raw payload, or chat body. Requester RTT uses same-device elapsedRealtimeNanos and is labeled application RTT. Host authority and OSI role explanation appear separately.
implementation.protocol: Android wire protocol bumped from danpan-lan-v3 to danpan-lan-v4; app versionCode 4/versionName 0.6.0-android-results-chat-comm. SQLiteOpenHelper schema 3 adds rematches, chat messages, and message ID hash tables.
